name: Hue food guide
summary: Start with bún bò Huế at Dong Ba, then cơm hến on Hen Island, then bánh khoái along Kim Long toward Thien Mu. The small cakes and nem lụi follow. A stall price is Check on arrival.
body: Hue eats a beef-and-pork noodle bowl, a clam rice on the river island, and a turmeric crepe on the north bank. It is not mì Quảng and not cao lầu. Those belong down the coast.

Give the first bowl to Dong Ba. Cross Ưng Bình bridge for Hen Island when you want cơm hến or bún hến, and skip the island in a flood week. Kim Long, on the way to Thien Mu, is the road for bánh khoái and bún thịt nướng. Nem lụi is a street stall Vietnam Tourism does not place on a named street. No stall price is published. The hour is Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Vietnam Tourism and the city’s culture department name these first: bún bò Huế, cơm hến, bánh bèo, bánh khoái, bánh nậm, and nem lụi.

sections.heading: Also ordered in Hue
paragraphs: Bún thịt nướng is the Kim Long lunch. Bún hến is the other bowl on Hen Island. Chè is the sweet soup Vietnam Tourism places in alleys: corn, lotus seed, taro, and a grilled-pork dumpling soup. No alley name was printed.

spots.name: Bun thit nuong
spots.note: Cold rice noodles with grilled pork, herbs, green papaya, carrot, cucumber, and lettuce. Vietnam Tourism says the peanut sauce is the Hue version and that the royal kitchen is the claimed origin. Pork goes on the noodles with sweet-sour fish sauce, then you toss. It is a lunch. A house number and a clock are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun hen
spots.address: Cồn Hến, across Ưng Bình bridge
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism says the stalls on Hen Island sell bún hến beside cơm hến. What is in the bowl was not printed. The walk on the island is under half an hour. The island disappears when the city floods. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Corn chè
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism names corn among the sweet soups in alleys. No alley name was printed. Order it after the meal. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Lotus-seed chè
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism names lotus seed among the sweet soups in alleys. No alley name was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Taro chè
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism names taro among the sweet soups in alleys. No alley name was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled-pork dumpling soup
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism includes a grilled-pork dumpling soup with the sweet soups in alleys. No alley name and no further recipe were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: The doors are markets and roads, not a booked room. Dong Ba is the morning market. Hen Island is the clam rice. Kim Long is the snack road toward Thien Mu. Chi Lăng and Bạch Đằng are the afternoon streets on the far side of the island. Plan 66 of 3 February 2026 also names Chi Lăng and Bạch Đằng inside a night anchor the city is still shaping, with Hoàng Thành and Bao Vinh.

spots.name: Dong Ba Market
spots.caption: The market front. Vietnam Tourism sends you here before bánh khoái and bánh bèo.
spots.note: Start here for produce, then the snacks. The city’s culture department places a bún bò Huế bowl inside the market. The street number and the door hour are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hen Island
spots.note: Cross Ưng Bình bridge and eat cơm hến or bún hến from the stalls. Vietnam Tourism says the walk is under half an hour and that the island disappears when the city floods. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Kim Long
spots.address: Kim Long, north bank toward Thien Mu
spots.note: The north-bank road that also leads to Thien Mu. Vietnam Tourism places bánh khoái and bún thịt nướng along it. Go in the daytime, on the pagoda ride. A door hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chi Lang and Bach Dang
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism’s itinerary names Chi Lăng and Bạch Đằng for the afternoon after Hen Island. Plan 66 of 3 February 2026 names the same pair as a night anchor still being shaped. Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Hue food guide — bun bo, com hen, cakes, and Kim Long
seoDescription: Bun bo Hue at Dong Ba, com hen on Hen Island, and banh khoai along Kim Long. Nem lui is a street stall. Stall price and hour are Check on arrival.
